newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norske Skog result seen flat.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norske Skog result seen flat.

text.p: Norwegian forestry group Norske Skogindustrier ASA is expected to post pre-tax profits of 1.42 billion crowns in the first nine months 1996, slightly down from 1.48 billion crowns recorded a year ago, a Reuter poll of nine analysts showed.
The analysts had adjusted downwards estimates for full-year results for 1996 and 1997 from projections in August.
The revision was due to expectations of a weaker market for newsprint paper with prices falling between 10 and 20 percent from current levels of about 1,100 marks per tonne, they said.

Net profits for 1996 were forecast at 1.30 billion crowns, a downward revision of 142 million crowns from August estimates, while estimates of 962 million crowns for 1997 were 144 million crowns lower than the previous poll.
Two of the analysts recommended a buy on the share, two said sell, four said hold and one decline to provide a recommendation.
Norske Skog will present none-month results at 0715 GMT on November 7. Following lists analysts expectations.
